title: Advising the Army of Allah: Ashraf Ali Thanawi's Critique of the Muslim League
note: Megan Eaton Robb's scholarly chapter on Thanwi's late-1930s advice to Muslim League leaders, his reservations, and the limits of his influence on the party.
whyItMatters: Distinguishes Thanwi's political counsel from straightforward party endorsement and documents the limits of his effort to influence the League.
